messages:
alex-sec: Heads-up: third-party penetration test scheduled for Mon 2026-03-22. Need a quick operational plan for RBAC, KMS gating, evidence packaging, and retest cadence. Can we list owners?
maria-sre: I can own the logging/export pieces. Plan: export CloudTrail + app logs, include SHA256 checksums, store in pt-readroom bucket with Restricted ACL.
kevin-ops: I'll own the readroom and presigned URL issuance. Quick constraints: no KMS Decrypt for assessors, ephemeral assume-role only, IP whitelisting to assessor CIDRs.
sec-bot: PenTest intake recorded: PT-2026-03 ID 9951. Please attach scope doc to the intake ticket.
alex-sec: For RBAC: create role assessor-pt-2026 with session policy (max 5h TTL). Only allow s3:GetObject for pt-artifacts/* and logs:Describe/Filter. No kms:Decrypt.
maria-sre: If assessors need to validate encrypted payloads, provide decrypted test vectors and envelope metadata. Otherwise, we risk exposing KMS material.
kevin-ops: For artifact delivery, prefer presigned S3 URLs with 72h expiry. Also provide a read-only snapshot of relevant Grafana dashboards as PNGs.
alex-sec: Remediation tracking: single tracker epic REM-2026-PT9951. Assign initial triage to squad leads. Owner: me.
sec-bot: Remediation epic created: REM-2026-9951.
maria-sre: Quick question about audit stream: do we want continuous streaming to the assessor or a point-in-time export? Continuous streaming may leak internal telemetry; recommend point-in-time signed export with checksum.
alex-sec: Agreed: point-in-time signed export. Add CloudTrail, VPC Flow Logs for scope, and app request traces for endpoints in scope.
kevin-ops: On network gating: I need the assessor egress CIDR and contact email to generate short-lived allowlist. Please post here.
oncall: I'll be oncall that week (2026-03-20 -> 2026-03-27). Pager on.
alex-sec: Proposed dry-run: Thu 2026-03-19 15:00 PT to validate access and artifact flows. Retest window: 2026-03-26 09:00-13:00 PT, contingent on fixes merged + CI green 72h prior.
maria-sre: I'll prepare export instructions and a sample manifest file with checksums. Example manifest line: pt-artifacts/logs-20260319.gz sha256:3a7f...
kevin-ops: Creating ephemeral role template and sample session policy below. We'll apply least privilege and remove any inline policies granting kms:Decrypt.
alex-sec: Also: evidence hygiene — sanitize PII, redact user identifiers where possible. We should include a data-handling note in the intake ticket.
kevin-ops: Intake ticket updated with assessor contact and CIDR. Presigned URLs will be uploaded there.
maria-sre: Will upload log export to intake ticket by EOD tomorrow, include SHA256 and size.
sec-bot: Dry-run scheduled: 2026-03-19 15:00 PT. Reminder will post 1h before.
alex-sec: Final owners: Alex = remediation epic lead, Maria = logs/export, Kevin = readroom & presigned URLs, Oncall = runbook escalation. Any objections?
oncall: All good.
alex-sec: Cool. Closing thread; follow-ups in PT intake PT-2026-9951 and REM-2026-9951.
